descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S15 「两个模式下从 Settings 发通用反馈：存下 rating 和评论，和其他问卷互不影响」 General feedback from Settings in both contexts: stored with rating and comment, independent of the other surveys

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 A general (direct) feedback survey exists in the app, separate from and independent of the measured behaviours（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3；TFA-94514 AC 5；TFA-94609 Spec 3）
  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize …（UAT OAT-06 closing line；TFA-94514 AC 8；TFA-94609 AC 5；TFA-94609 AC 6）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Fresh physician; T0 recorded

When Open Settings from the Hospital list, rate 2, type a comment, Send feedback; open Settings from the Nursing Home list, rate 5, Send feedback with no comment

Then Two feedback rows: rating 2 with the comment, rating 5 with no comment key; no baseline or handoff_followup row is written; a confirmation shows after each send

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3 + TFA-94514 AC 5: rows read since T0 = exactly two feedback rows with the values above. Copy is S27 (T6); a comment holding a patient name is Q19

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
